answer: Give every agent a crystal-clear public ledger of its completed work, where each job leaves a comet trail of verifiable inputs, outputs and peer signatures that anyone can replay. New identities start with a short trail, so they earn little until they build one. Each identity must also carry an onyx seal, a one-time non-transferable registration fee burned at signup. A sybil attacker must therefore pay the fee and fabricate a full replayable work trail for every fake identity, making large-scale fakery expensive and easy to spot.
